title: Per-Layer Token Budget Is a Binding Enforceable Control
description: The agent module shall transition a node to failed with reason token_budget_exceeded when per_layer_token_budget is set and would be exceeded.
rationale: A per-layer budget sub-cap prevents a single layer from consuming the entire course token allowance before the human has reviewed it; marking nodes failed rather than silently skipping them ensures the escalation path triggers and the student can observe the cause.
